verdict.rationale: Trello has a Power-Up marketplace. Users can browse it to 'find the apps your team is already using' and link their favorite tools [trello-docs-7][trello-docs-4], and developers can submit Power-Ups to it [trello-docs-15], backed by a developer platform and REST API [trello-docs-16][trello-docs-21]. Community posts confirm third-party plugins are in real use [trello-comm-11], though one older report notes add-on restrictions for solo users [trello-comm-2]. missing for 10: evidence of the 'thousands' scale of the catalog, a concrete list of named third-party integrations beyond Slack/email/calendar/Jira, and current independent corroboration of the plan limits on Power-Ups.
